SnowDistribution: Icy paths and hillsides, main snow line above 800 metres. Good visibility.   Winds approx 10mph or less.
Comment:
There is still the potential for small avalanches in the Low  Avalanche Category
Small avalanches in steep terrian can have serious consequenses
WeatherInfluences: Mostly dry with very occasional snow flurries.  Fresh to strong South-East winds will increase to gale force early on Sunday, easing through the day and backing to become East-South-Easterly.
SnowStability: New windslab will develop on West to North aspects mainly above 1000 metres.  Although poorly bonded these accumulations are expected to be isolated, sometimes localised and mostly affect coire rims and the tops of gullies. On these aspects fragile cornices will develop.  Wind exposed areas will become scoured. The avalanche hazard will be Low.
ObservedWeatherInfluences: A cold sunny day with light Northerly winds.  The freezing level rose to 900 metres by midday.
ObservedSnowStability: There is a cover of soft snow above 800 metres on all aspects. Isolated and localised accumulations of generally well bonded windslab were observed on North-Westerly aspects above 1000 metres. The avalanche hazard is Low.
